lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatamaa raam na poojanee doojai kiu sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: They do not worship the Lord, the Supreme Soul; how can they find peace in duality?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai a(n)tar mail hai sabad na kaadhahi dhoi ||
lines.translation: They are filled with the filth of egotism; they do not wash it away with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈਲਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai mailiaa mue janam padaarath khoi ||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, they die in their filth; they waste the priceless opportunity of this human life. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bole a(n)dhule tis mahi aganee kaa vaas ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deaf and blind; they are filled with the fire of desire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਨੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee surat na bujhanee sabad na karahi pragaas ||
lines.translation: They have no intuitive understanding of the Guru's Bani; they are not illumined with the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa aapanee a(n)dar sudh nahee gur bachan na karahi visaas ||
lines.translation: They do not know their own inner being, and they have no faith in the Guru's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaaneeaa a(n)dar gurasabad hai nit har liv sadaa vigaas ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is within the being of the spiritually wise ones. They always blossom in His love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕੀ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har giaaneeaa kee rakhadaa hau sad balihaaree taas ||
lines.translation: The Lord saves the honor of the spiritually wise ones.I am forever a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jo har sevade jan naanak taa kaa daas ||21||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of those Gurmukhs who serve the Lord. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮੁ ਸਰਪੁ ਹੈ ਜਗੁ ਘੇਰਿਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa bhuia(n)gam sarap hai jag gheriaa bikh maai ||
lines.translation: The poisonous snake, the serpent of Maya, has surrounded the world with its coils, O mother!

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa maaran har naam hai gur garuR sabad mukh paai ||
lines.translation: The antidote to this poisonous venom is the Name of the Lord; the Guru places the magic spell of the Shabad into the mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur miliaa aai ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with such pre-ordained destiny come and meet the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil satigur niramal hoiaa bikh haumai gaiaa bilaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, they become immaculate, and the poison of egotism is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa ke mukh ujale har daragah sobhaa paai ||
lines.translation: Radiant and bright are the faces of the Gurmukhs; they are honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤਿਨ ਜੋ ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sadaa kurabaan tin jo chaalahi satigur bhaai ||22||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh niravair hai nit hiradai har liv laai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has no hatred or vengeance. His heart is constantly attuned to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: niravairai naal vair rachaaidaa apanai ghar lookee laai ||
lines.translation: Whoever directs hatred against the Guru, who has no hatred at all, only sets his own home on fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar krodh aha(n)kaar hai anadin jalai sadaa dukh paai ||
lines.translation: Anger and egotism are within him night and day; he burns, and suffers constant pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਨਿਤ ਭਉਕਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਧੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR bol bol nit bhaukade bikh khaadhe doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: They babble and tell lies, and keep on barking, eating the poison of the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh maaiaa kaaran bharamade phir ghar ghar pat gavaai ||
lines.translation: For the sake of the poison of Maya, they wander from house to house, and lose their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੇਰੇ ਪੂਤ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: besuaa kere poot jiu pitaa naam tis jaai ||
lines.translation: They are like the son of a prostitute, who does not know the name of his father.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam na chetanee karatai aap khuaai ||
lines.translation: They do not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the Creator Himself brings them to ruin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har guramukh kirapaa dhaareean jan vichhuRe aap milaai ||
lines.translation: The Lord showers His Mercy upon the Gurmukhs, and reunites the separated ones with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo satigur laage paai ||23||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam lage se oobare bin naavai jam pur jaa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: Those who are attached to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are saved; without the Name, they must go to the City of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai sukh nahee aai gae pachhutaahi ||24||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, they find no peace; they come and go in reincarnation with regrets. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taa dhaavat rahi gae taa(n) man bhaiaa ana(n)d ||
lines.translation: When anxiety and wanderings come to an end, the mind becomes happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaadee bujheeai saa dhan sutee nichi(n)d ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the soul-bride understands, and then she sleeps without worry.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa tinhaa bhetiaa gur govi(n)d ||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahe har paaiaa paramaana(n)d ||25||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they merge intuitively into the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa gurasabadee veechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who serve their True Guru, who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n lain har naam rakhahi ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: who honor and obey the Will of the True Guru, who keep the Lord's Name enshrined within their hearts,

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਮੰਨੀਅਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai othai ma(n)neean har naam lage vaapaar ||
lines.translation: are honored, here and hereafter; they are dedicated to the business of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪਦੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sabad sinjaapade tit saachai darabaar ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the Gurmukhs gain recognition in that Court of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਖਰਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saudaa kharach sach a(n)tar piram piaar ||
lines.translation: The True Name is their merchandise, the True Name is their expenditure; the Love of their Beloved fills their inner beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਆਪਿ ਬਖਸੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal neR na aavaee aap bakhase karataar ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them; the Creator Lord Himself forgives them.
